WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT p.throws, COUNT(*) AS award_count
    FROM manager_award AS ma
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
    GROUP BY p.throws
), shares AS (
    SELECT throws, award_count,
           CAST(award_count AS REAL) / SUM(award_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_counts
), summary AS (
    SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total_count,
       AVG(average_share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM summary
WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: A missing throwing hand is grouped as SQL NULL, which forms its own group; only hands represented by matched manager award rows are included when computing the average share.
